packs.notes: Skyrim Unbound. No more cart ride. New Game now asks where in Skyrim you wake up, and the launcher connects you to the server by itself once your save has loaded.
Server password
Fixed the plugin list
Launch the build's Skyrim, not Steam's
Server preset, launcher opens on the main monitor
Server preset, launcher opens on the main monitor
Stop publishing the client's browser cache
Mod list rows open the mod's page
Mod list rows link to their mod page, and a Skyrim that will not close gets closed
Fixes the favourites menu crash and the empty world map
Favourites crash, empty world map, doubled HUD bars
Favourites crash, empty world map, doubled HUD bars, bigger inventory text
Tab menu lockup, favourites crash, doubled bars, minimap, editable keybinds
Remove the icon injector, fix the inventory overhang, minimap position
Map markers at full brightness and bigger, larger inventory text and icons, Recheck now also checks for updates
Map markers at full brightness, bigger inventory text and icons, no more weapon recoil off walls, Recheck also checks for updates
The notice boards work now. Missives puts real contracts on the boards in and around every town, generated fresh, and each of you takes your own off the board rather than sharing one.
Dying now sends you to the Temple of Kynareth or the nearest Hall of the Dead instead of dropping you next to your own corpse. Walk back for your things.
Fixed the update check, quieter publish output, Yoku Weapons links to its page
Server address off the launcher pages, news posts now list what actually changed
Hunger, thirst, exhaustion and cold now switch themselves on. The launcher configures SunHelm for you the first time you make a character, so nobody has to go hunting through menus.

Three test starter classes, so I can confirm how Unbound stores them

Character slots, carriages, and damage that knows where it hit
- Play now asks who you are, two slots with their own saves, and walks straight past Skyrim's main menu
- an empty slot makes a new character, and characters can be deleted without the saves being destroyed
- carriages and ferries run between the holds, as a fade rather than a scripted ride so it survives co-op
- where you hit somebody now matters, with the settings shipped identically to everyone
- new bodies for everyone, CBBE and 3BA for women, HIMBO and The New Gentleman for men, with CBPC physics
- three starter classes to test, Smith, Thief and Warrior

- The current settings entry stays hidden

- Begin Your Adventure lived on the Main page, so picking a class is now the only way to leave the starting room
- Play is greyed out in the launcher while an update is waiting and reads UPDATE FIRST
Making a character now walks you through it. The starting location menu opens on its own after the face, and the class menu follows.
